units.rawText: They say that I ought to act like a proper preacher. I have to be kind, dignified, fair, saintly and reserved.

units.rawText: How many people are really like that in this world anyway? Even a squeaky clean robot is going to grow mildew if you keep it in a filthy cage for long enough.

units.rawText: Soaked in sin, bound by logic, stored in dark corners... now, I can smell the evil in a sinner's heart even when I hold my nose.

units.rawText: The only way to soothe the frustration in my neural cloud is to cleanse that disgusting stench with my very own hands.
